name: AI-supplychain
description: Traqify — AI-powered supply chain intelligence. Streamlit + MySQL + scikit-learn dashboard for demand forecasting, anomaly detection, inventory and shipment analytics.

paragraphs: Turn raw operational data — uploads, shipments, sales — into forecasts, anomaly alerts and reorder decisions in one dark, dashboard-grade Streamlit app.
If the live demo is asleep, click “Yes, get this app back up!” to wake it. First load can take 30 seconds.

Traqify is a full-stack supply chain analytics platform. Point it at a spreadsheet or a MySQL warehouse and it turns operational records into the things a supply chain team actually argues about: what will we sell next quarter, which supplier keeps slipping, what is about to stock out, and what capital is rotting on the shelf.
features: Real-time KPI header — total revenue, delayed shipments, low-stock items, product count
(each animated on load, with an automatic currency-aware delta)
Monthly revenue trends as interactive Plotly bars with hover templates
Demand forecasting for the next N months using scikit-learn LinearRegression

whatItDoes.text: Turn raw operational data — uploads, shipments, sales — into forecasts, anomaly alerts and reorder decisions in one dark, dashboard-grade Streamlit app.

requirements.text: Open create an account (verify the emailed OTP), then upload sample/supplychaindemo.xlsx from the sidebar.
Sessions — Streamlit sessionstate; every login, upload, status change and chat
